newsitem.title: UK: LME zinc, copper hold onto gains in AM kerb.
newsitem.headline: LME zinc, copper hold onto gains in AM kerb.

text.p: ZINC - Ends midday kerb near day's high at $1,594, up $23 after pre-market rally. Cash/threes back wings out to $60, vs $40.
COPPER - Below early highs but still $18 stronger at $2,310 on short covering. Thin volumes.
ALUMINIUM - Just softer at $1,651, cash/threes touch easier at $6/$3 contango. LEAD - Softer. NICKEL/TIN - Firmer.
